resources.string: MIDICon for Android is a companion to your MIDICon web server. Uploads, YouTube imports, progress, editing, and downloads use the server’s transcription engines. An internet connection and a reachable HTTPS server are required; this APK does not run the Python models offline.
No file picker is available on this device.

The studio could not be loaded. Check your connection and server URL, then retry.
The server returned HTTP %1$d. Check that this is a running MIDICon server.
The server’s HTTPS certificate could not be verified. Use a valid certificate; this app does not bypass TLS errors.
This MIDICon server still needs model setup. Finish server setup, then connect again.
The health check returned HTTP %1$d. Enter the root URL of a MIDICon server.
